reports.name: OWASP ZAP Baseline
prerequisites: Docker Desktop is running (open from Start menu / Applications / systemctl start docker)
pwsh start-app.ps1 has been run and the local stack is up on :8000, :4000, :5173
The zaproxy/zap-stable image is present locally (the script pulls it if missing)
expectedOutput: HTML report at reports/zap/zap-baseline-report.html with no High alerts
A summary of Medium / Low alerts (informational; ZAP baseline does not fail on these)
Console log shows the number of alerts and the time taken

The auth API is up on :4000 (curl http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/health returns 200)
expectedOutput: HTML report at reports/zap/zap-baseline-report-auth.html
No High alerts on the auth endpoints

reports.name: Lighthouse CI
reports.command: Triggered by the .github/workflows/lighthouse.yml job on every pull_request
prerequisites: The job installs Ollama, Node 18, Python 3.11, and the project deps automatically
Ollama must be running with the llama3.2 model pulled (the job does this)
The FastAPI analyzer must be reachable on :8000 from the runner
expectedOutput: Performance category score >= 0.5 (warn threshold from lighthouserc.json)
Accessibility category score >= 0.7
Best-practices category score >= 0.7
All resource-size budgets within the .github/lighthouse/budget.json limits
Assert: true promotes warn-level failures to errors so a regression blocks the PR

reports.name: Performance Benchmarks (pytest-benchmark)
reports.command: Triggered by the .github/workflows/perf.yml job on every pull_request
prerequisites: The job installs Ollama, Python 3.11, and pytest-benchmark automatically
Ollama must be running with the llama3.2 model pulled (the job does this)
The FastAPI analyzer must be reachable on :8000 from the runner
expectedOutput: bench.json with mean / stddev / median / iqr for each benchmark
No benchmark regresses by more than 25% on mean or stddev vs the stored baseline
First run with no baseline: stored as .benchmarks/baseline.json for the next comparison

actualLastRun.lastModified: no local artifact; CI uploads as a build artifact

reports.name: Scenario Matrix (Playwright)
prerequisites: Python venv exists at venv/ with requirements installed (python -m pip install -r requirements.txt)
Node deps installed in backend/ and frontend/ (npm install in each)
Ollama is running on :11434 with llama3.2 pulled
The FastAPI analyzer is reachable on :8000
The Express auth API is reachable on :4000
The React dev server is reachable on :5173
expectedOutput: Three scenarios pass with their expected top-ranked resume and minimum score:
- python_ml_llama32: top=resume_strong_python.pdf, score>=50
- data_engineer_llama32: top=resume_data_engineer.pdf, score>=45
- frontend_react_llama32: top=resume_frontend.pdf, score>=45
A scenario-report-*.html file with one article per scenario and a Verdict pill in the Approval row

reports.name: AI Code Review (LLM-driven)
reports.command: Invoke the Code Review Policy skill in chat. The LLM produces a fresh report, writes the JSON, the hash, and the checklist HTML; you paste the one-liner in chat to regenerate checklist-report.html.
prerequisites: The AI Skill is registered (skills/code-review-policy/SKILL.md exists)
The pre-push hook is installed (git config core.hooksPath .githooks)
Ollama is not required for the review itself; the LLM does the review in chat
expectedOutput: last-report.md with a trailing 'VERDICT: <verdict>' line on the last line
last-checklist-data.json with every section populated and a checkedItems array
checklist-report.html with 39 tickable checkboxes, all ticked by the LLM
Verdict is one of: Approve | Approve with Suggestions | Request Changes
The pre-push hook reads the verdict and blocks on Request Changes

reports.name: AI Security Review (LLM-driven)
reports.command: Invoke the Security Review skill in chat. The LLM produces a chat report and a structured HTML file.
prerequisites: The Security Review skill is registered (skills/security-review/SKILL.md exists)
No infrastructure prerequisites; the review is LLM-driven
expectedOutput: Chat findings inline in the conversation
An HTML report at skills/reports/security-review-<mode>-<date>.html with 10 fields per finding
Safe-mode reviews (secrets-hygiene, test-data-pii) use redacted input data
